issues.description: The problem statement specifies that SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) should return a double (the UML shows : double and the text explicitly requests double precision for financial calculations). In the solution implementation, calculateTotalPrice is declared to return an int (public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)). This return-type mismatch contradicts the specification and would confuse students about the expected method signature and precision.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the calculateTotalPrice method use the double return type to match the problem statement. Change the signature in SealSaloon to `public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)` and compute/return a double (e.g., use a double accumulator and add ingredient prices as doubles). Ensure any template/stub and tests expect a double as well.
